scope: Noncanonical, replayable reduced reference column on explicit native T0 support. Static adjudication only; no state or production evolution created.

time.B6N2_post_event_kinematics_during_T0_T1: NOT_APPLICABLE; do not use as physical forcing for the open pre-event interval
time.same_age_causal_states: T1 PRE_EVENT and T1 POST_EVENT have the same physical age and distinct causal semantics.

state_and_configuration.thermal_state: T(z) over identified native column support; derived/replayable, not a current canonical payload.
geometry: authored continental H or ocean HWR finite-plate support
state_and_configuration.material_identity: Model reference roles only; explicit native-support role join required; no composition inference.

spatial_scope.coverage: Only cells with governed q/age/domain/geometry support and a valid explicit material-role join; preserve UNKNOWN and fail closed outside support.
spatial_scope.resolution: Native source-cell resolution only; no interpolation, global extrapolation, or resolution promotion.
spatial_scope.Buck_section_mapping: Deferred to B6N8-F; a per-cell column is not itself a Buck section or section-support authority.

initializer.continental: Existing analytical fixed-geometry transient-rate profile with T(H)=T_ad(H), authored q/TSurf, reference layers and source term; effective Tdot is a snapshot closure, not a time-history primitive.
initializer.ocean_ridge: Existing HWR-2 profile, deterministic series and Hermite projection; source-defined age-zero ridge inversion.
initializer.selected_scope: T0 reduced reference-profile construction only, conditional on support/material-role binding and provider validation.
initializer.pre_T0: The formula can be evaluated without stepping a numerical model before T0 once inputs are authorized. PRE_T0_HISTORY_REQUIRED remains NOT_DEMONSTRATED; history is not proven unnecessary.

boundaries.T0_surface: Existing TSurf reference and governed domain q rule; no climate interpretation.
boundaries.T0_base: Model-specific thermal/adiabatic matching and finite-plate rule in B6N8J_LAB_BASAL_BOUNDARY_DECISION.json.
boundaries.event_transition: B6N1 activation is a causal event at the T1 endpoint; it does not authorize an instantaneous thermal discontinuity. T1 PRE_EVENT thermal state is eligible to serve as the T1 POST_EVENT thermal payload only if no separately authorized instantaneous thermal transition exists. This is a requirement, not a generated state.

candidate_evolution.equation_status: Candidate form only; not selected as a complete T0-to-T1 physical model.

timescale_diagnostic_only.length_convention: sqrt(kappa*t); 2*sqrt(kappa*t) is also reported as an error-function e-fold scale.
timescale_diagnostic_only.limits: Diagnostic only using specialist ranges whose target-material applicability remains conditional. Does not establish a steady initial profile, invariant geometry/boundaries, or negligibility of advection/other processes.

persistence.derived_profile: DERIVED_REPLAYABLE_T0_STATE only with pinned parents, recipe/version, support, validity and configuration hashes; canonical publication requires separate authorization.
persistence.solver_iterates: temporary, not WORLD_HISTORY epochs by default

post_event_thermal_semantics: POST_EVENT causal semantics do not imply an instantaneous thermal jump. No temperature reset, heat pulse, geotherm change, or material-property jump is authorized by B6N1 activation alone. T1 PRE_EVENT profile may be reused as T1 POST_EVENT thermal payload only if no separate instantaneous thermal transition is authorized; no state is generated here.
